uploadReservationStatus: Local batch: 223 embedded checks passed with one native-only load skip; twelve focused upload-budget checks, type checking, production build and HTTP smoke passed. Native PostgreSQL last-slot concurrency verification remains pending. School-wide versioned policies default uploads disabled, support upper-human approval/master self-approval, and keep exact values/reasons out of generic audit. Current file/domain/upload rights and metadata version guard each reservation. A tenant-bound native helper atomically charges claimed bytes/count once, using protected cached counters. Duplicate requests, archive/timeout and budget reductions do not erase existing allocations; failed audit/outbox writes roll back charges. Restricted database grants deny direct usage-counter rewrites and reservation release/deletion. Bot ceilings, current private-domain rights, uploader-safe limits without school totals, tenant isolation and strict inputs passed locally. This is capacity reservation only: no URLs, physical upload proof, scan evidence, provider calls or cleanup credits. R2 signing is still unmounted; the complete physical file pipeline remains unfinished.
storageStatus: Private R2 service signing boundary is implemented using pinned official SDK packages. Six local checks independently recalculate SigV4 signatures and detect method/path/query/size/type/conditional-header tampering; tests contact no storage server. Academy-bound opaque keys separate quarantine uploads from clean downloads; TTLs are capped, configuration/metadata are strict and service handles close explicitly. The frozen full local suite passed 202 checks with one native-only load check skipped. Type checking, production build, HTTP smoke and dependency audit passed. This adapter is not mounted in the web process and does not prove a bucket is private or live R2 works. File metadata/search/access, scan-state enforcement, completion, promotion, content/malware checks, quotas, multipart support, cleanup, bucket/CORS/privacy and live-provider evidence remain unfinished. Do not delete quarantine while grants are valid. Issued bearer links have residual access until expiry; role revocation is not immediate token revocation. No actual storage calls or files are used in tests.
verificationNotes: A preceding local status-adapter full-suite run lasted 6347693 ms and failed the five-attempts-per-60-seconds authentication assertion: that subtest lasted 624362 ms and received 401 instead of 429. No production throttling policy or assertion was relaxed. The subsequent frozen rerun completed in 96177 ms, passed all 185 local checks, and passed the same throttling subtest in 242 ms. Native enrollment CI independently passed authentication and all 193 PostgreSQL checks. These timings are observed evidence, not a proven diagnosis of why the earlier run was delayed.
